Adding more fuel to the fire is the fact that Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 recordings automatically captures footage from the last 30 seconds of gameplay, which is exactly how long the video above lasts.

While controversial online at the time of their announcement, FireRed and LeafGreen's eye-opening $20 price point (each) did nothing to stave off demand to buy the games again (despite other GBA games simply being offered as part of the Nintendo Switch Online subscription).
